meals_goal_a_clear_steady_mind:
Goal: a clear, steady mind for long study days — focus, memory and energy without a slump after lunch. Built on the MIND diet.

Every day:
- Leafy greens (spinach, kale, salad) and other vegetables.
- Berries, blueberries best; a handful of nuts, walnuts best.
- Olive oil as the main fat.

Every meal:
- Protein: fish, eggs, chicken, legumes, tofu or Greek yogurt.
- Slow carbs only: whole grains, oats, buckwheat, brown rice, legumes. No white bread, sweet pastries or sugary sauces.

Often:
- Oily fish (salmon, mackerel, sardines) 2–3 times a week, for omega-3.
- Eggs (choline), beans, dark chocolate (70%+).

Little or none:
- Sugary drinks and sweets, fried and deep-fried food, fast food, processed meat.
- Red meat, butter and cheese: rarely.
- Heavy, greasy portions before study: a moderate lunch (about 500–700 kcal), so it doesn't make you sleepy.
- Alcohol.

Coffee and tea before 14:00 only: sleep does more for the brain than anything on the plate.

This is a general default, not medical advice: replace it with your own diet.
meals_goal_lose_weight_slowly_while:
Goal: lose weight slowly while the brain keeps working at full power.

- Meals of about 400–600 kcal: half the plate vegetables and greens, a palm of lean protein (fish, chicken, eggs), a fist of slow carbs.
- For the brain: oily fish 2–3 times a week, berries, a small handful of nuts, olive oil.
- Soups, salads with fish or chicken, bowls, grilled dishes; sauces on the side.

Avoid: sugary drinks and juices, sweets, pastries, fried food, creamy sauces, alcohol.

This is a general diet, not medical advice.
meals_goal_plenty_of_protein_for:
Goal: plenty of protein for training, on top of food for the brain.

Every meal:
- 30–40 g of protein: fish, eggs, chicken, turkey, cottage cheese, Greek yogurt, legumes.
- Vegetables, leafy greens and slow carbs: buckwheat, brown rice, oats, potatoes.

For the brain: oily fish 2–3 times a week, berries and nuts every day, olive oil as the main fat.

Avoid: sugary drinks and sweets, deep-fried food, fast food, processed meat; heavy, greasy lunches before study.

This is a general diet, not medical advice.

phone_no_pin_is_open_press_pair: No PIN is open: press “Pair a phone” in the PC settings.
phone_the_phone_isnt_paired_with_this: The phone isn’t paired with this PC — pair again with a PIN.
phone_this_pc_build_has_no_phone: This PC build has no phone APK.
phone_too_many_attempts_open_a_new: Too many attempts — open a new PIN on the PC.
plan_blocks_not_started_can_be_shortened: Blocks not started can be shortened and removed, a started one — shortened down to the time already worked. Worked time is never erased.
plan_changes_to_this_plan_will_be: Changes to this plan will be lost.
plan_empty_add_the_first_block_e: Empty. Add the first block — e.g. “Math, 1.5 h”.
plan_every_block_runs_in_parts_of: Every block runs in parts of {seg} min with breaks between them. Breaks don’t eat into study time.
plan_it_leaves_the_plan_but_stays: It leaves the plan, but stays in the log
plan_lunch_a_nap_a_walk_stands: Lunch, a nap, a walk — stands in its place in the day, not counted as study
plan_no_plan_on_a_day_off: No plan on a day off — and that’s fine. You can add something light.
plan_plan_saved_and_made_the_template: Plan saved and made the “{today_kind}” template
plan_starts_by_itself_when_the_block: Starts by itself when the block before it closes.
plan_template_every_day_starts_like_this: Template: every {k} day starts like this
plan_template_unless_untouched: — unless today hasn’t started and its plan wasn’t edited
plan_the_day_template_every_such_day: The “{target}” day template: every such day starts with it. It doesn’t change today’s plan{unless}.
plan_the_next_days_of_this_type: The next days of this type start with this plan
pwa_meal_picks_from_the_pc_come: Meal picks from the PC come as notifications.
pwa_no_picks_yet_they_come_before: No picks yet: they come before each meal.
pwa_notifications_are_off_turn_them: Notifications are off: turn them on in Settings → Notifications → ClockManage.
pwa_notifications_only_work_from_the: Notifications only work from the Home Screen: tap Share (in Safari at the bottom, in Chrome in the address bar) → Add to Home Screen, then open ClockManage from there.
pwa_on_the_pc_open_clockmanage_meals: On the PC open ClockManage → Meals → Pair an iPhone, then scan the QR code or type the code here.
pwa_picking_a_notification_comes_in: Picking: {meal}. A notification comes in 1–3 minutes; nothing after 5 minutes — check that the PC is on.
pwa_sent_to_the_pc_it_applies: Sent to the PC: it applies the diet within a minute while it is on.
pwa_the_code_didnt_work_check_it: The code didn’t work: check it, or pair again on the PC.
pwa_the_pc_picks_restaurants_and: The PC picks restaurants and dishes for your diet; a notification comes in 1–3 minutes.
segment_a_segment_can_only_start_during: A segment can only start during a break or between blocks.
segment_a_segment_needs_a_name_and: A segment needs a name and a duration.
segment_all_blocks_of_the_day_are: All blocks of the day are closed — the lock is off
segment_ends_with_an_alarm_it_cant: “{name}” ends with an alarm — it can't run untimed.
segment_first_min_to_get_ready_countdown: — first {prep_min} min to get ready, countdown{extra} from “In bed”
segment_in_bed_after_min_getting_ready: {name}: in bed after {now} min getting ready — {extra} in {planned_min} min
segment_is_already_over_access_opens: “{name}” is already over: access opens only while it runs.
segment_no_such_segment_in_the_queue: No such segment in the queue.
segment_press_in_bed_first_theres_no: Press “In bed” first — there's no countdown while getting ready.
segment_taken_ahead_of_the_plan_the: “{name}” taken ahead of the plan — the planned one won't start a second time
settings_a_block_is_cut_into_parts: A block is cut into parts of this length. A tail shorter than 15 min sticks to the last part: 50 min is one part.
settings_a_hand_drawn_card_on_top: A hand-drawn card on top of all windows at every step: alarm, break, closed block, “Nope”.
settings_a_local_server_for_claude_it: A local server for Claude: it sees the timer state and the stats and can set the plan. Listens on 127.0.0.1 only.
settings_a_ring_at_the_end_of: A ring at the end of a break, a soft signal at the end of work and a fanfare when a block closes.
settings_a_study_day_is_running_time: A study day is running. Time settings change freely: what would loosen today (an earlier day end, longer breaks) starts tomorrow. Move today’s day end on the Today screen. The block list can only grow.
settings_after_a_closed_block_blocked_th: After a closed block. Blocked things open (Blocking → Access in breaks)
After a closed block. Blocked things stay closed
settings_at_night_start_day_works_only: At night “Start day” works only in the app window and only after holding the button: the tray, the mini timer and the phone don’t start a day. So a stray click can’t start a new day.
settings_auto_follows_the_system_the_lan: “Auto” follows the system: the language of the interface, notifications and log entries.
settings_between_the_parts_of_one_block: Between the parts of one block
settings_cards_on_top_of_the_screen: Cards on top of the screen
settings_click_a_day_to_pick_its: Click a day to pick its type
settings_clockmanage_looks_for_a_new_ver: ClockManage looks for a new version in GitHub Releases every 6 hours. The AppImage downloads and installs it by itself when no study day or lock is running, the window is closed and nobody has touched the PC for 5 minutes, and comes back in the tray. A .deb installs it when you press Restart and update (it asks for your password), and so does the AppImage on a desktop that doesn't report idle time. Settings and the log are kept.
settings_end_of_work_a_break_and: End of work, a break and a block
settings_every_6_hours_clockmanage_looks: Every 6 hours ClockManage looks for a new version in GitHub Releases, downloads it and installs it when no study day or lock is running, the window is closed and nobody has touched the PC for 5 minutes. The app comes back by itself, in the tray; settings and the log are kept.
settings_every_such_day_starts_with_this: Every such day starts with this plan. Today’s plan is edited on the Plan screen.
settings_from_github_releases: From GitHub Releases, in the background
settings_if_another_program_uses_the_por: If another program uses the port. Update the address in Claude afterwards.
settings_if_the_day_hasnt_started_by: If the day hasn’t started by then, the block list goes on and holds until “Start day”
settings_inverted_colours_a_dark_pill_in: Inverted colours: a dark pill in the light theme and a light one in the dark. Never gets lost on any background.
settings_inverted_colours_visible_on_any: Inverted colours — visible on any background
settings_lunch_a_nap_a_walk_non: Lunch, a nap, a walk — non-study time with a countdown
settings_mb_a_paired_phone_offers_the: MB). A paired phone offers the update by itself, over Wi-Fi.
settings_new_port_update_the_address_in: New port: {port}. Update the address in Claude.
settings_no_hosts_and_browser_policies_n: No — hosts and browser policies need the .deb package; apps are closed anyway
settings_no_hosts_browser_policies_and_c: No — hosts, browser policies and closing apps are unavailable
settings_no_lock_on_such_a_day: Such a day has no lock — and no autolock either
settings_non_study_segments_with_a_count: Non-study segments with a countdown: the Segment button on a break, or a plan item. A notice 5 minutes before and at the end, then every 5 minutes — how much over. At the start you can pick “Untimed” — a stopwatch counting up. The lock works as on a break. During study — only shorter.
settings_off_nothing_of_it_runs: Off: nothing of it runs or goes online
settings_off_only_by_the_check: Off: only by the Check button
settings_on_such_a_day_start_day: On such a day “Start day” closes the listed sites and apps — until the day end or until the whole plan is done.
settings_on_the_meals_screen_is: On: the Meals screen is in the menu
settings_one_click_starts_the_day_any: One click starts the day at any time
settings_open_clockmanage_on_the_phone_i: Open ClockManage on the phone in the same Wi-Fi network, pick this PC and enter the PIN. Valid until
settings_optional_before_each_meal_an: Optional. Before each meal an agent picks food that fits your diet on a delivery service (Wolt) and can send the picks to an iPhone. While it is off, none of it runs or goes online, and the Meals screen and its MCP tools are hidden.
settings_phone_unpaired_pair_again_with_: Phone unpaired — pair again with a new PIN
settings_rest_after_a_closed_block_befor: Rest after a closed block, before the next one. During study — only shorter.
settings_rest_between_the_parts_of_one: Rest between the parts of one block. It doesn’t eat into study time. During study it can only get shorter.
settings_sites_apps_and_the_phone_are: Sites, apps and the phone are blocked as during study until you start the day. A notice comes 5 minutes before. Started earlier — nothing happens. Only emergency access opens it early. The day log records when it went on and how many minutes later the day started. Never on a day off.
settings_starts_when_you_sign_in_and_a: Starts when you sign in, and a systemd user service brings it back within 5 minutes if the process was killed. Can’t be turned off during study.
settings_starts_when_you_sign_in_comes_b: Starts when you sign in, comes back after being closed
settings_starts_when_you_sign_in_to: Starts when you sign in to Windows without a UAC prompt, and restarts every 5 minutes if the process was killed. Can’t be turned off during study.
settings_starts_with_windows_comes_back_: Starts with Windows, comes back after being closed
settings_the_autolock_is_on_until: The autolock is on until “Start day”. Time settings change freely; an earlier day end starts tomorrow. The block list can only grow.
settings_the_clockmanage_android_app_see: The ClockManage Android app sees the timer over Wi-Fi, can pause, start parts and change block lengths. Offline it keeps counting on its own. It blocks the listed sites and the chosen apps on the phone too.
settings_the_colour_exactly_as_picked_th: The colour exactly as picked — the boldest accents
settings_the_day_end_dates_and_the: The day end, dates and the log follow this clock. Can only be changed outside the lock.
settings_the_end_is_a_loud_alarm: The end is a loud alarm that rings until you press “I’m up” (even with the sound off). No 5-minute warning. For naps.
settings_the_language_of_the_interface_n: The language of the interface, notifications and log entries. “Auto” follows Windows.
settings_the_lock_lifts_at_this_time: The lock lifts at this time
settings_the_phone_and_the_pc_must: The phone and the PC must be on the same network. Apps blocked on the phone are set on the Blocking screen.
settings_time_to_get_ready_before_the: Time to get ready before the countdown: coffee, getting to bed. The segment waits for “In bed”, and when the time is up it only reminds you. The countdown and the alarm start from “In bed”. 0 — the countdown starts at once.
settings_today_is_a_day_plan_updated: Today is a {kind} day, plan updated
settings_today_is_running_changes_apply_: Today is running — changes apply to the next days
settings_version_is_available_it_install: Version {version} is available. It installs by itself when no study day is running and nobody is at the PC
settings_version_is_downloaded_it_instal: Version {version} is downloaded. It installs by itself when no study day is running and nobody is at the PC
settings_when_the_lock_lifts_by_itself:
When the lock lifts by itself, even if the plan isn’t done. During study this default can only move later.
To move just today (later or earlier, up to 02:00 at night), click the time on the Today screen.
settings_when_the_lock_lifts_how_a: When the lock lifts, how a block is cut into parts and how long you rest.
settings_while_the_segment_runs_until_it: While the segment runs (until its planned end), blocked things are open — like lunch at the PC. Can only be turned on outside study.
settings_while_the_timer_waits_for_start: While the timer waits for “Start part”, the ring repeats at this interval. After the day end it stays quiet.
settings_your_own_type_shower_10_min: . Your own type: “Shower 10 min”. Segments are added to the day on the Plan screen.
system_couldnt_create_the_autostart_task: Couldn’t create the autostart tasks (administrator rights needed).
today_all_blocks_done_the_lock_is: All blocks done — the lock is off
today_block_closed_at_the_time_worked: Block closed at the time worked — logged
today_blocked_things_stay_closed_during_: Blocked things stay closed during a pause.
today_blocked_things_stay_closed_on_a: Blocked things stay closed on a pause — they open in the break between blocks.
today_day_end_other_hint: Later or earlier, up to 02:00 at night, with a reason
today_during_study_the_day_can_only: During study the day can only get denser
today_lunch_at_the_pc_access_open: Lunch at the PC — access open
today_or_until_the_plan_is_done: or until the plan is done
today_sites_and_apps_are_open_until: Sites and apps are open until {time}
today_the_day_is_closed_a_denser: The day is closed: a denser type reopens it — the new blocks are added and the lock comes back.
today_the_day_is_running_the_new: The day is running: the new type’s blocks are added to the plan, nothing started is lost.
today_the_lock_turns_on_at_or_with_start: The lock turns on at {time} or with “Start day”
today_the_lock_turns_on_with_start: The lock turns on with “Start day”
today_today_only_the_setting_stays_every: Today only — the setting stays {day_end_base}. Every shift goes to the log.
today_todays_day_end_later_or_earlier: Today’s day end — later or earlier
today_todays_day_type_its_own_plan: Today’s day type: its own plan and lock
today_todays_plan_is_replaced_with_this: Today’s plan is replaced with this type’s template.
today_untimed_a_stopwatch_no_end_reminde: Untimed — a stopwatch, no end reminders
today_what_was_boring_what_distracted_yo: What was boring, what distracted you?
tray_a_focus_lock_runs_until_only: A focus lock runs until {clockmanage_core}. Only emergency access lifts it earlier.
tray_a_study_day_is_running_the: A study day is running. The lock lifts after all blocks or at the day end.
tray_the_autolock_is_on_it_lifts: The autolock is on. It lifts with “Start day” or at the day end.
ui_a_lighter_day_its_own_plan: A lighter day — its own plan
updater_it_installs_by_itself_when_no: It installs by itself when no study day is running and nobody is at the PC, or press Restart and update in Settings.
updater_press_restart_and_update_in_sett: Press Restart and update in Settings (outside a study day).
updater_the_update_installs_after_the_st: The update installs after the study day: a restart now would stop the timer.
view_getting_ready_then_min_press_in: Getting ready · then {r} {planned_min} min — press “In bed” when you lie down
